verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਭਈ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਮਤਿ ਮਨ ਉਨਮਨ ਲਿਵ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਏ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: charan saran gur bhiee nihachal mat man unaman liv sahaj samaae hai ||

en.bdb: In the refuge of Satguru the intellect becomes stable. The mind attaches itself with state divine and rests in equipoise.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦਰਸ ਅਰੁ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਰਮਦਭੁਤ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨੇਮ ਉਪਜਾਏ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: dhirasaT dharas ar sabadh surat mil paramadhabhut prem nem upajaae hai ||

en.bdb: With the mind engrossing into the teachings of Satguru and divine word residing for ever in the memory, astonishing loving devotion is generated.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ ਰੰਗੁ ਹੁਇ ਤੰਬੋਲ ਰਸ ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸਿ ਧਾਤ ਕੰਚਨ ਦਿਖਾਏ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: gur sikh saadh sa(n)g ra(n)g hui ta(n)bol ras paaras paras dhaat ka(n)chan dhikhaae hai ||

en.bdb: In the company of devoted Sikhs, one gets dyed in the color of the Lord; they give their fragrance like a betel leaf and as metal can become gold when touched with the Philosophers-stone; so becomes the state of devoted Sikhs.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚੰਦਨ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਸੰਧਿ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਸੁਬਾਸ ਤਾਸ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਕਹਤ ਨ ਆਏ ਹੈ ॥੮੫॥
verses.translit_en: cha(n)dhan suga(n)dh sa(n)dh baasanaa subaas taas akath kathaa binodh kahat na aae hai ||85||

en.bdb: The touch of the Holy Feet, a glimpse of the True Guru, passes on fragrance like the sandalwood, which makes other trees equally fragrant. This state of ecstasy is beyond words. (85)
